records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Glad to have Union Collective on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 (fast start), but no invites sent and no reply to three outreach emails (email:deb70e7b, email:86ff7483, email:7da321af) over 6 days; no tickets, Starter solo use. Engagement appears to have gone quiet, so unaided key milestone within 8 days is unlikely but plausible.

draft.subject: Next step on your Union Collective project
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

You've got your first project set up in Wrenfield, which is the main hurdle — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

The usual next step from here is bringing in one teammate: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if you'd rather add a few at once.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whichever next step is most useful for your team.

Best,
Priya
